title: How to Set the 404 Redirect Page as the Homepage
text:
## How to Set the 404 Redirect Page as the Homepage
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000099697
To set up a 404 redirect to the homepage in Brilliant Directories, you'll need to use the Advanced Settings. Here's how:
Navigate to the " Settings " section.
Click on " Advanced Settings ".
To set a new 301 redirect page, search for the " Default 404 Error Page " setting.
Use the dropdown to select the existing Web Page that will be used as the redirect.
Select the " /home " option.
Click on the " Save " button to apply the redirect page.
This will ensure that any visitors who try to access the non-existent page will be redirected to your homepage instead of seeing a 404 error.
If you need more information, this article may be helpful: Update 404 Error Pages
